title: RAFT: Reward rAnked FineTuning for Generative Foundation Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with human preferences (which includes harmlessness and the reduction of implicit biases and toxicity) using a reward model trained on the Anthropic Helpful and Harmless (HH-RLHF) dataset, as well as conducting GPT-4 and human evaluations on response quality.
